realPilotEvidence.feedback: Real evidence strengthened existing classifications without claiming parity for pending profile, dirty-repository, authority, manual-test-session, or system-project sub-capabilities.

secondRealPilotEvidence.feedback: A materially different real repository reconfirmed Orca isolation, compact handoffs, independent verification, false-success rejection, Stable protection, and human adoption authority. It also exposed a pre-implementation feasibility gap for local IDs against seeded concept registries; no pending capability was promoted on this evidence alone.

thirdRealPilotEvidence.feedback: A third real repository reconfirmed exact discovery, Balanced planner/worker separation, isolated candidates, independent verifier revision loops, Stable protection, receipt binding, and Orca-native product checks. Passing tests and an initial verifier did not override contrary narrow-screen browser evidence; no pending capability was promoted on this evidence alone.

coverageRule: A non-PENDING state means foundation or overlay behavior exists; it does not claim final legacy parity unless separately proven.
